title: Edit Form Settings » Submission Settings
text:
## Edit Form Settings » Submission Settings
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000078794
In this article, we will be going over the Submission Settings that can be found under Edit Form Settings:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090906305/original/a712kWvdkfSpuleCOxLAgamgnDn3Gy-CZQ.png?1617648645 | alt: ]

## What Happens After Form Submitted Setting & Additional Options
This setting will allow the website owner to select an action to perform after the form is submitted.
If the Display Success Pop-Up Message option is selected, the system will display an option to edit the Success Message Text on the fly:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090906457/original/Ps8CVqnHmOrlaAw3XiUHamF1qhAMTJPKVA.png?1617648919 | alt: ]
The wording added here will display after the form is submitted:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090906518/original/SoEb9M4UGIYvfE51D2l6C6uUMSAyumT3gw.png?1617649015 | alt: ]
If the Display Success Alert Message option is selected, the system will display an option to edit the Success Message Text on the fly:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090906561/original/fTq4qL2Zwb0G9ZThCoKDGWS9iSy6RtmV4A.png?1617649109 | alt: ]
The wording added here will display after the form is submitted:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090906604/original/DVBNkaXBYSZBwOsLDaVMiD-6yVVvGha0rA.png?1617649185 | alt: ]
If the Redirect to Another Page option is selected, the system will display an option to edit the destination URL and the Success Message Text:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12091441496/original/kDjr0C89yszYVgSw7p2ntEh_U-uNsjj5Lg.png?1618582983 | alt: ]
When the selected form is submitted, the system will redirect the user to the specified URL:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12091442098/original/whZof7KDevwOAN69h2XsdxnNTyk7QA91Ag.gif?1618583526 | alt: ]
Save Member Information option should only be selected for member account forms like Contact Details, Listing Details, post type forms and About Me:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12093607855/original/7lGXBddLjlBxqqljI3OXweIg2_yfiSqWvw.png?1622818587 | alt: ]
If this option is not selected for the forms specified, member information will not be saved in the database.
